name: Strategy Code Graph
purpose: Read-only structural code intelligence over explicitly indexed GitNexus repositories.

connection.upstream_endpoint: loopback GitNexus MCP endpoint defined by the host deployment

notes: Existing production deployment retained as an independent control/fallback for cgrmcp.
Raw Cypher, mutation, and group routing are excluded from the ChatGPT-facing read-only surface.

reconstruction: Run the existing GitNexus MCP service on its private loopback endpoint with read-only mode and repository allowlisting.
Run tunnel-client as a separate persistent service and inject the GitNexus bearer token upstream.
Create a private ChatGPT plugin using Connection: Tunnel and bind it to that tunnel.
Use no ChatGPT-side OAuth/API-key auth when the tunnel handles the upstream bearer.
Verify the expected read-only tool surface before use.
secrets_policy: Never commit tunnel IDs, OpenAI runtime keys, GitNexus bearer values, or credential file contents.
